counters.name: guardrails-commit-guard-spawns
counters.command: mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/performance-ratchet" && env -u CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=plugins/guardrails bash plugins/performance/scripts/spawn-census.sh --shim-dir "$HOME/.cache/performance-ratchet/shim" --label guardrails-commit-guard --no-ledger --tool awk --tool git --tool jq --tool sed --tool grep --tool dirname --stdin '{"tool_name":"Bash","cwd":".","tool_input":{"command":"git commit -m \"feat: add x\""}}' -- bash plugins/guardrails/hooks/run-guards.sh --lib lib/powershell/ps-command.sh block-no-verify.sh block-dangerous-git.sh block-hook-bypass.sh flag-commit-pr-skill-bypass.sh block-noncanonical-commit.sh block-convention-violation.sh block-windows-drive-tmp.sh block-exported-msys-pathconv.sh block-root-delete-target.sh | grep -F ' rc=0 '
counters.goal: The Bash PreToolUse guard row spends at most this many external processes judging a git commit with no convention cache (plugins/guardrails/hooks/hooks.json, block-convention-violation.sh).

counters.name: guardrails-posttooluse-run-guards-spawns
counters.command:
bash scripts/hook-census.sh guardrails PostToolUse cli-flag-verify.sh '{"session_id":"census","hook_event_name":"PostToolUse","cwd":"@DIR@","tool_name":"Edit","tool_input":{"file_path":"@DIR@/README.md","old_string":"Census","new_string":"See `docs/old.md`."},"tool_response":{"filePath":"@DIR@/README.md","success":true}}' --setup 'g() { git -c user.name=census -c user.email=census@example.invalid "$@"; }; mkdir docs && echo x >docs/old.md && g add docs/old.md && g commit -qm add && g rm -q docs/old.md && g commit -qm rm && printf "# Title

See \140docs/old.md\140.
" >README.md' --check 'grep -q docs/old.md "$HOOK_STDOUT"'
counters.goal: The PostToolUse Edit(*.md) verify bundle (cli-flag-verify, skill-reference-verify, stale-path-verify through run-guards.sh) spends at most this many process creations and execs on an Edit whose new text cites a path the repository deleted. #4390 measured 87 processes per PostToolUse:Edit fire on Windows. The count includes every process git, jq, grep, sed and awk start themselves, so a runner image that changes one of them can move it: measured 103 on ubuntu-24.04 with bash 5.2.21, git 2.55.0, jq 1.7, gawk, strace 6.8, and 103 in an ubuntu:24.04 container with git 2.43.0 and mawk. The row's leading `bash` (#4442) removed the `/usr/bin/env` exec: 102 on the same ubuntu-24.04 runner. The ratchet step prints the current versions.
